title: A Undertow for the Inventory
author: Ivo Dunmore
blurb: Ansel Crane, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
